when: any tap on the glass that is not a feed
Eleven Labs prompt: Tiny dry retro UI blip: a single 8-bit tick like a fingernail tapping aquarium glass. About 60 ms, bright mid-high pitch, no bass, no reverb, instant clean stop.

notes: a plink or splash; once per drop, not per pellet
Eleven Labs prompt: Small cute water plink: a food pellet dropping onto the surface of a fish tank, stylized as a soft chiptune bloop with a tiny splash tail. About 250 ms, bright and clean, no bass, no reverb.

light_on: a short two-note rising chiptune chirp, like a small lamp switching on; about 200 ms, bright, dry, no bass. light_off: the same two notes descending, a soft power-down boop; about 200 ms, gentle fade.

notes: soft, loopable while the stroke moves? v1: one cue per stroke
Eleven Labs prompt: Soft squeegee wiping wet glass, stylized as a gentle 8-bit swoosh with a faint rubbery squeak. About 300 ms, mid-high frequencies only, no bass, smooth fade out.
Quick crisp scissor snip cutting a plant stem, stylized as a tiny retro game cut click. About 100 ms, bright, dry, no reverb, no tail.

card_open: a quiet soft UI pop, a single gentle chiptune pip rising slightly, like a small card sliding up; about 120 ms. card_close: the same pip falling slightly, quieter; about 100 ms. Both bright, dry, no bass.

when: setup and birth-flow letter wheel detent, YES/confirm
notes: tick must be < 40 ms; the wheel spins fast
Eleven Labs prompt: wheel_tick: an extremely short mechanical detent click like a rotary dial ratchet tick; about 30 ms, dry, bright, no tail at all. confirm: a friendly two-note ascending chiptune OK chime; about 300 ms, warm but bright, clean fade.

notes: 2-4 variants, max one per 250 ms, pitch by stage (fry high, elder low)
Eleven Labs prompt: Tiny cute munch: a soft round 8-bit bloop with a little downward pitch dip, like a small fish gulping a pellet. About 150 ms, bright mid-high, no bass, dry. Make 3 or 4 variants with slightly different pitch and timing.

notes: once per spook episode, not per tap
Eleven Labs prompt: Startled quick descending zip: a fast pitch-drop chiptune whoosh like a small fish darting away in fright. About 250 ms, bright, dry, no bass.

when: a long hold draws a fish over (trust earned)
Eleven Labs prompt: Gentle curious rising purr: two soft ascending chiptune notes like a shy fish drifting closer to investigate. About 400 ms, warm, quiet, smooth fade, no bass.

when: a fish reaches the column for play (GOAL_VISIT_BUBBLES arrival)
Eleven Labs prompt: Playful cluster of small air bubbles rising and popping at the surface, stylized as bubbly chiptune blips at varying pitches. About 500 ms, bright, light, no bass, no reverb.

when: a hungry fish begging at the glass
notes: very quiet, cooldown 30 s per fish; never at night
Eleven Labs prompt: Very quiet plaintive 8-bit chirp: two soft notes with a slight wobble, like a hungry little fish asking at the glass. About 300 ms, gentle, no bass, fades to silence.

when: a fresh install: the first-run setup's welcome page comes up (setup_begin when progression_setup_pending())
notes: the tank's very first sound; a reset (BOOT+tap, YES) lands here too, so it is also the "new tank" sound. Up to ~2 s. Plays once per setup flow, never on an ordinary boot
Eleven Labs prompt: Warm hopeful retro game startup jingle for a tiny pixel-art fish tank waking up for the first time: four or five ascending chiptune notes that bloom into a shimmering bubbly finish. About 2 seconds, bright, cheerful, no bass, clean fade out.

when: a fry arrives / birth flow announce
Eleven Labs prompt: Joyful little fanfare for a newborn fish arriving: a short bright chiptune flourish with a rising bubbly sparkle on top. About 1.5 seconds, celebratory but small, no bass, clean fade.

when: a milestone or checklist line earned
Eleven Labs prompt: Short achievement chime: three quick ascending bright chiptune notes ending in a small sparkle. About 500 ms, clean, no bass, no reverb.
Level-up growth chime: a rising four-note chiptune arpeggio landing on one held bright note. About 700 ms, triumphant but tiny, no bass, clean fade.

notes: wake plays after the codec is up, so ~100 ms into the boot
Eleven Labs prompt: sleep: a soft descending three-note chiptune yawn that slows down, like a small device drifting off; about 600 ms, gentle, fades to silence. wake: the same three notes ascending, a bright fresh good-morning boop; about 500 ms, clean.
Short flat error bonk: a single dull low-mid retro buzz followed by a quick double blip. About 300 ms, dry, nothing below 600 Hz.
